title: Active Era Mummy Sleeping Bag 300 GSM — Comfort down to 0 °C, Water-Repellent
short_description: Mummy sleeping bag with 300 GSM hollow fibre filling, comfort range 10 °C to 0 °C and extreme range down to -10 °C. Water-repellent 190T polyester and drawstring hood — for camping and outdoors.
long_description: The Active Era mummy sleeping bag (model SB-M300) has 300 GSM hollow fibre filling. According to the manufacturer, the comfort range is 10 °C to 0 °C, and it is rated down to -10 °C in extreme conditions. The mummy shape hugs the body to retain warmth, and the drawstring hood protects head and neck. An insulated zip blocks draughts, and an anti-snag design makes opening and closing easy. The durable 190T polyester is water-repellent. At around 1 kg with a small pack size, it suits camping, tents and outdoor trips. An inner pocket with Velcro holds your phone and valuables.
